name: Median Graphs Are Strictly Contained in Conditional Antimatroids
statement: Every finite median graph admits a conditional-antimatroid presentation, and the inclusion is strict.
proof: Median classes are conditional antimatroids. The vertex-deleted cube $Q_3^-$ is a convex-geometry ideal and hence conditional, but the majority of $110,101,011$ is the missing vertex, so its graph is not median.
